caption: The drawing features two objects, each with accompanying handwritten notations. On the left side is a depiction of a medicine bag made of painted hide. The bag is rectangular, measuring 11 by 11.5 inches, and has angular, geometric designs outlined in dark brown or black, filled with shapes in shades of red, yellow, blue, and tan. The top of the bag has a looped tie closure. On the right side is a drawing of a rawhide feather case that is cylindrical and measures 15.5 by 4 inches. The case displays alternating horizontal bands of brown, red, and muted yellow, with visible surface texture suggesting paint and hide. A looped handle is attached to one side of the case. The background is a plain tan or beige paper, and the drawing is done in colored pencil or crayon with fine black pencil or ink for outlining and annotation. Labels and descriptions are written clearly around each object, including dimensions, material, and the artist’s signature with a date of October 9th, 1935.
title: Medicine Bag and Feather Case
